title: Content conversion config
description: Site-specific data consumed by wp_template/bin/content-tools/. Every value here is DATA, not prose: chrome signatures, the functional-shortcode allowlist, the palette slug map, and the inventory scope. The conversion tools and the divi-to-gutenberg skill read this so the tools stay site-agnostic.

table_prefix.description: WP DB table prefix (informational; the dump uses WP_Query).

chrome.description: Signatures for site chrome that is stripped before conversion.

global_modules.description: DIVI global_module ids that are chrome (breadcrumb band, footer). Empty array = treat ANY global_module as chrome.

disabled_on_values.description: disabled_on attribute values meaning hidden on all devices, e.g. 'on|on|on'.

breadcrumb_shortcodes.description: Shortcode names that render a breadcrumb (dropped with the global module).

footer_text_signatures.description: Literal text fragments that uniquely identify a footer-nav section to drop (fallback when the footer is not a global module).

wave_divider_attrs.description: DIVI section attribute names for decorative wave dividers (dropped as cosmetics).

content_modules.description: Module base-names (without et_pb_ prefix) that count as real content. A section holding NONE of these (only spacers/waves) is dropped as chrome.

functional_shortcode_allowlist.description: Non-DIVI shortcode names that must survive conversion VERBATIM (in a core/shortcode block for the gutenberg target, or on their own line for markdown). Entries match as a name prefix at a word boundary: 'pdf' matches [pdf-embedder], 'cmplz' matches [cmplz-document].

allowed_block_namespaces.description: Extra non-core block namespaces that are legitimate passthrough in already-Gutenberg content (e.g. complianz/document). Informational for validation.

palette.description: Named brand color slugs -> hex. Callout colors map to the NEAREST slug only when a close shade; everything else is dropped. Content never emits hex.

post_types.description: Post types to inventory (include custom types).

statuses.description: Post statuses to inventory (include custom statuses).

curated_slugs.description: Page slugs that are hand-authored/curated -> always classify markdown.

expected_skips.description: Post ids intentionally left unconverted (empty/awaiting editorial). Verification treats these as expected, not failures.

layout_modules.description: DIVI module base-names whose presence forces the gutenberg (block) target rather than markdown.
